title: Spain Just Sent Its Military Into One Of Its Own Cities
text:
Spain just sent its military into one of its own cities.

Thousands of migrants broke through the border fence between Morocco and the Spanish exclave of Ceuta this week. Officials report at least 9 deaths, with some outlets now putting the toll as high as 18. Spain's government is deploying the Armed Forces to back up the Civil Guard, and the Prime Minister is flying in personally.

This isn't a war zone. It's a 7-square-mile Spanish city of about 85,000 people, on the coast of Africa, that just saw thousands more arrive in a matter of days.
